title: Questions artifact v2
description: A question set: generated, curated (golden), refined or merged. v2 renames the question text field from v1's `text` to `question`, the key the normalizer and every generator use; questions.v1 files are still read (see dokimi.questions.artifact). Objects stay open like v1, because the pipeline passes curated question files through verbatim and their authors attach their own keys; every key a producer in this repo writes is declared here.

library.description: Product the set is for (curated sets, `eval questions refine`).

library_id.description: Doc-source identifier of the product, e.g. a GitHub `org/repo` (curated sets).

description.description: Free-text description of the set (curated sets).

version_or_doc_snapshot.description: Which product version or documentation snapshot the set was written against (curated sets).

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the generator wrote the set (`eval questions generate`).

total_questions.description: Number of questions in the set (`eval questions generate`, pipeline).

total.description: Number of questions in the set (`eval questions refine`).

difficulty_distribution.description: Question count per normalized difficulty label after refinement (`eval questions refine`).

question_set_hash.description: 12-hex-digit SHA-256 prefix over the set's ids and question texts; answers and eval artifacts carry the same value (pipeline).

question.description: The question text. Was `text` in questions.v1.

text.description: Not allowed: questions.v1's name for `question`. A record carries its text under one key only, so readers cannot disagree on it; writers rename it (dokimi.questions.artifact).

persona.description: Who asks: a persona id or label, or a persona object.

personas.description: Ids of every persona the question was generated for; deduplication merges the lists of the questions it folds together.

persona_id.description: Persona id; the pipeline sets `manual` on curated questions that carry none.

difficulty.description: Difficulty label or number. The normalizer maps it to beginner / intermediate / advanced; curated sets use easy / medium / hard.

level.description: Workflow depth, independent of difficulty. See docs/difficulty-rubric.md.

expected_topics.description: What a good answer covers: short keyword labels in generated sets, verified answer statements in curated sets (see docs/methodology.md, Grounded Judging).

topics.description: Seed topics the question was generated from.

expected_skill.description: Skill (or list of skills) the question is meant to exercise; null when none should apply (curated sets, `eval triggers generate`).

metadata.description: Free-form provenance: generator model/persona for generated questions; citations (`must_cite`, `github_issue`, `verified_by`), `why_it_matters`, `negative_case: true` and similar for curated ones.

prompt_style.description: `verbatim`: the answerer sends `question` as written, without its expert-answer wrapper (set by `eval import`, whose graders score the reply to the original prompt).

grading.description: Format-neutral reference checks from an imported eval (`eval import`): `checks` (match, exact, fuzzy, regex, choice, json, judge, unsupported), optional `threshold`, `source_format`, `native_scorer`. Scored by `eval score reference`; see dokimi.eval.reference_checks.

source_type.description: Where the pipeline got the question: `generated` or `manual` (a curated or --custom-questions file).

question_source.description: How a generated question was made: `persona` or `chunk` (grounded in a documentation chunk).

ground_truth_chunk.description: Documentation text a chunk-grounded question was written from; the judge grades against it.

chunk_index.description: Index of that chunk in the fetched documentation.

source_url.description: URL the chunk was fetched from.

validation_score.description: Aggregate quality score from question validation (`eval questions generate --validate`), 0-100.

trigger_lint.description: `eval triggers generate` lint of the query against the catalog (`names_skill`, `echo_terms`, `exam_framing`, `lexical_rank`, `unknown_expected`, `label_unresolved`, ...).

source_text.description: The question text before `eval triggers generate --rewrite` turned it into the user-voice `question`; absent when it was not rewritten.
